annotations.title: Analyze an image into a case

description: Analyze one image and attach the result to an existing case. Spends credits at the usual rates (D1 1, D2 2, D3 10). Capped at 20 analyses an hour per account, and a connected app is limited to depth 2. Returns the analysis and the case id. Reads the scene only (architecture, signage, terrain, vegetation), never the people in it. No face recognition, no biometric identification, no person matching. It answers where an image was taken, never who is in it, and must not be used to locate or track a person.

depth.description: Analysis depth. 1 = Surface (1 credit). 2 = Standard (2 credits). 3 = Forensic (10 credits; agent tokens with maximum depth 3 only).

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the image to analyze.
